resources.string: Allow camera access to start taking photos.
Unable to finish. Please try again.
Connection lost. The result is not confirmed; please retry.
You cannot chat with this person right now.
Your session has changed. Please log in again.
The previous send may have arrived despite the lost connection. Reload the conversation before resending to avoid duplicates. Discard only this device’s pending attempt?
No eligible moments. You can only attach photos both people already have permission to view.
Unfriend @%1$s? You will no longer be friends.
Block @%1$s? Your friendship and pending requests between you will be removed.
The action succeeded, but the list could not reload. Select Reload.
Use only a–z, numbers and underscores, up to 255 characters.
Too many searches. Wait a moment before trying again.
This request or friendship has changed. Reload the list before continuing.
This user or request is unavailable. Reload the list.
Cannot connect. Reload to confirm the current state before trying the action again.
Unable to load friends. Please retry.
Cannot load moments. Check your connection and retry.
The server cannot load moments right now. Try again later.
This moment will be removed from the server. Recipients will lose access after syncing; previously exported photos cannot be removed remotely.
Cannot delete while disconnected. Please retry.
Cannot delete this moment. Please try later.
Cannot save photo to device. Please retry.
Storage permission is required to save photos.
Theme saved. To preserve your input, this screen will update when the form is empty or reopened.
History is not implemented yet. Received and sent moments will be added in a later step.
Profile is not implemented yet. You can still log out using the button above.
Using front camera. Switch to rear camera
Using rear camera. Switch to front camera
Theme saved. This screen keeps your current work; the new theme will appear when reopened.
Find and connect with the people closest to you.
Preview only. Not sent or saved to your gallery.
Capture a moment and review it before sending.
No friends yet. Connect in the Friends tab.
Cannot load friends. Your photo is kept so you can retry.
Only selected friends can view this photo. Up to 100 friends per send.
Sent to friends and loaded back from the server. Not saved to your gallery.
Photo not sent. Check your connection, select 1–100 friends and confirm your friendships before sending.
The photo and message will be saved only to your account, not sent to selected friends.
Preview photo unavailable. Go back and take a new photo.
The send request conflicts or its content changed. Please retry.
Enter a display name between 1 and 255 characters.
Unable to update profile. Please retry.
Cannot finish. Check your connection or choose another photo, then retry.
Only verified emails can be used for recovery. The temporary password lasts 15 minutes and can only be used to change your password.
If this email is registered, we will send a temporary password to your inbox.
Confirm your current password, then enter the code sent to your registered email. Verify before you need account recovery.
If verification is needed, a code has been sent to your registered email. It expires in 15 minutes.
Email verified. You can now use password recovery.
This session only allows password changes. Log in again afterwards; all previous sessions will be revoked.
Password changed. Please log in again.
Enter the exact 43-character code from the email.
Your new password must differ from the current or temporary password.
The password or code is invalid, already used or expired. Check it or request a new one.
This password-change session expired. Request a new temporary password.
Too many requests. Please wait and retry.
Secure session storage is unavailable. Passwords and tokens will not be stored in plain text.
Local network permission granted. Please submit again.
Local network permission is needed for the debug server. You can try granting it again.
Session removed from this device. Server-side revocation could not be confirmed.
Camera permission is needed. If repeatedly denied, enable it in App Settings.
Cannot open or capture with the camera. Please reopen it.
Photo saved privately. Only you can view it.
Send or download could not be confirmed. Check your connection and retry. If the server received it but the response was lost, resending may create another private photo.
Four themes are available across account, Camera, Preview, photo viewer, History, Friends, Messages and Profile screens. Open screens keep your current work until reopened.
Cannot save theme. Your preview is kept; try Apply again.
